notes: Sideways page; the digitized table 3 is the block "Sisquoc River near Garey (drainage area 442 square miles)" of Table 3 (measured runoff, in acre-feet, at eight gaging stations in the Santa Maria River drainage system in the water years 1904-45, continued); the other two blocks on the page (La Brea Creek near Sisquoc, Tepusquet Creek near Sisquoc) are not part of it. Rows are water years 1940-41 to 1944-45 with one column per month; in the 1940-41 row October to January are dashes, so the first printed value is February 1941 (the water year 1940-41 itself begins 1940-10). "Total" column is a summary. State is from the running head (Geology and ground-water, Santa Maria Valley, Calif.).
